maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes mainly from manufacturing and selling new RVs (Airstream, Jayco, Heartland) through dealers, not repair or aftermarket work.

publicly_funded.reason: New RVs are bought by consumers via dealers; leisure purchases, not government-funded.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through RV brands' own sales and products; past acquisitions like Jayco and Erwin Hymer were occasional large deals.

mission_critical.reason: Dealers and consumers can choose among competing RV makers; discretionary recreational vehicles with low switching cost.
